description: This file is a complete HTML webpage implementing a database visualization interface. It includes UI components such as sidebar for database selection, expandable table views, loading/error states, and interactive elements, with embedded JavaScript for dynamic data fetching and rendering.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays list of databases in sidebar

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resets current selections

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads and displays tables for a selected database

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data from a specific table

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs the HTML table from data array

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates a table cell, with handling for large content and objects

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for large or object data
